GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

6. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

7. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

9. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

13. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

14. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
